profile_text.body:
SoundHound AI, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Claymont, Delaware, and trades under the ticker SOUN. Its website describes the company as offering the OASYS platform, which it says powers voice-native AI agents that resolve service, operations, and commerce conversations for enterprise brands. The site includes unattributed customer statements about faster request resolution, more efficient order processing for franchisees, and always-on voice experiences through hybrid cloud and embedded connectivity.

SEC records identify the company by CIK 0001840856. Delaware court records list 33 matters involving the company. The available material names no products other than OASYS, and no MCP servers or tracked products are listed.
